sections.title: Evolution or Illusion? Rethinking Evaluation in LLM Evolutionary Search
sections.abstract: The paper evaluates LLM-driven evolutionary search across a full grid of seeds and iteration counts, showing that strategy rankings and the best width/depth budget split can change with the task and budget.
sections.claimed_contribution: A seeds-by-iterations frontier and practical budget guidance.
sections.caveat: Evidence covers three strategies and five tasks.

sections.title: Steering Equilibrium Selection in Regularized Self-Play via the Reference Policy
sections.abstract: The paper studies whether the reference policy in entropy-regularized self-play can deliberately steer selection among value-equivalent Nash equilibria.
sections.claimed_contribution: Reference anchoring steers self-play toward target equilibria in exactly solvable games.
sections.caveat: Demonstrated on exactly solvable games with reported failure modes.

sections.title: Colla-Q: Toward Collaborative Experts in MoE Quantization via Minimax Precision Balancing
sections.abstract: Colla-Q allocates quantization bit widths across MoE experts using activation entropy to balance post-quantization performance.
sections.claimed_contribution: Activation-entropy allocation for robust MoE quantization.
sections.caveat: The abstract gives no model-by-model numerical gains.

sections.title: MAPS: Memory-Aware Predictive Scheduling Framework for Large Language Model Serving
sections.abstract: MAPS predicts output-length upper bounds and uses hierarchical scheduling to reduce imbalance and head-of-line blocking in disaggregated LLM serving.
sections.claimed_contribution: The authors report 42.6% lower average latency and up to 84.8% lower tail latency.
sections.caveat: Evaluation covers two workloads and two LLMs.

sections.title: Generative Interpretability via Scalable Neuro-Symbolic Models
sections.abstract: The paper argues for inference-time, human-readable checkpoints that can be causally inspected or intervened on in agentic systems.
sections.claimed_contribution: A definition of generative interpretability and a neuro-symbolic implementation route.
sections.caveat: Primarily a position and framework proposal.

sections.title: Generalized Agent Iteration: One Formal Framework for Iterative Policy Improvement and Recursive Self-Improvement
sections.abstract: Generalized Agent Iteration unifies iterative policy improvement and recursive self-improvement by modeling systems as configurations whose components can be evaluated and modified.
sections.claimed_contribution: Two axes distinguish internal improvement mechanisms and externally anchored evaluation standards.
sections.caveat: The abstract does not provide empirical validation of the taxonomy.

sections.title: A Multi-Stage Agentic Framework for Effective Counter-Narrative Generation and Refinement
sections.abstract: The paper combines generation, refinement, human evaluation, and safety analysis in a multi-agent framework for countering hate speech and misinformation narratives.
sections.claimed_contribution: Iterative refinement improved reported persuasiveness and simulated narrative-strength reduction.
sections.caveat: Evidence is partly simulated and domain-specific.
